name: vscode-azdo-workitems
description: Your Azure DevOps work items in the current sprint: the Backlog Items and Bugs assigned to you, with their tasks, branches, pull requests, CI runs and alerts.

commands.title: Fill Integrated in Build with the Last Release
Show CI Runs of My Pull Requests
Check Pull Requests Waiting for My Review
Check Out a Pull Request Waiting for My Review

azdoWorkItems.organization.description: Azure DevOps organization. Leave empty to detect it from the 'origin' remote.

azdoWorkItems.project.description: Azure DevOps project. Leave empty to detect it from the 'origin' remote.

azdoWorkItems.repository.description: Azure DevOps Git repository. Leave empty to detect it from the 'origin' remote.

azdoWorkItems.teams.description: Teams whose current iteration is listed. Leave empty to list all the teams you belong to.

azdoWorkItems.remote.description: Git remote pointing to Azure DevOps.

azdoWorkItems.baseBranch.description: Branch new branches are created from and pull requests target.

azdoWorkItems.filter.types.description: Work item types shown. Empty: all types. Also editable with the Type chips of the view.

azdoWorkItems.filter.hiddenStates.description: Work item states hidden. Also editable with the State chips of the view.

azdoWorkItems.filter.hiddenPullRequestSt.description: States of the main PR of the work items hidden ("No PR" for work items without PRs). Also editable with the PR chips of the view.

azdoWorkItems.filter.hiddenPriorities.description: Priorities hidden ("P1" … "P4", or "No priority"). Also editable with the Priority chips of the view.

azdoWorkItems.stateOrder.description: Order in which the work items are sorted by state. Case, spaces and dashes are ignored. States not listed go last.

azdoWorkItems.branchTypeByWorkItemType.description: Branch prefix per work item type. Types not listed use 'feature'.

azdoWorkItems.branchModules.description: Catalog of modules used in branch names: <type>/<module>/<id>-<slug>.

azdoWorkItems.prFeatureNames.description: Catalog of feature names used in PR titles: [ids] Feature Name: Description.

azdoWorkItems.moduleToFeature.description: Feature name preselected in the PR title for each branch module.

azdoWorkItems.linkBranchToWorkItem.description: Add the new branch to the work item's Development section.

azdoWorkItems.stateOnBranchCreated.description: State a work item is moved to when a branch is created for it, per work item type. Only applied to work items in New, Approved or To Do. Remove a type to disable it.

enumDescriptions: Votes of the reviewers (approved, waiting for author, rejected…)

azdoWorkItems.notifications.events.description: Events of the pull requests you created that show a notification. Empty: no notifications.

azdoWorkItems.notifications.pollInterval.description: How often your pull requests are checked, in seconds.

azdoWorkItems.alerts.enabled.description: Show alerts on the work items with problems the team agreed to avoid.

azdoWorkItems.alerts.workItemTypes.description: Work item types checked for alerts.

azdoWorkItems.alerts.blockingTags.description: Tags meaning a work item cannot be completed yet: an alert is shown when a work item with one of them is started. Case is ignored.

azdoWorkItems.alerts.pullRequestTaskPatt.description: Regular expression (case is ignored) recognizing the PR task among the tasks of a work item by its title.

states.description: Only in these states. Empty: always

fields.description: Field names, as shown in Azure DevOps (or reference names)

azdoWorkItems.alerts.requiredFields.description: Fields that must have a value. Fields that do not exist in the project are ignored.

azdoWorkItems.integrationBuild.field.description: Field filled with the last release of the deploy image (display name or reference name).

azdoWorkItems.integrationBuild.workItemT.description: Work item types for which the field is offered when they move to one of the states below.

azdoWorkItems.integrationBuild.states.description: States in which the field must be filled. Moving a work item to them from the extension offers to fill it.

azdoWorkItems.integrationBuild.feed.description: Azure Artifacts feed (of the current project) publishing the deploy image.

azdoWorkItems.integrationBuild.package.description: Package whose last published version is used.

azdoWorkItems.integrationBuild.protocolT.description: Protocol of the package (UPack for Universal Packages).

azdoWorkItems.integrationBuild.suffix.description: Appended to the version: the fix ships in the release after the last published one.

azdoWorkItems.pipelines.pollIntervalSeco.description: While a CI run of your pull requests is queued or running, how often its state is refreshed (seconds). Checks stop when every run is finished.

azdoWorkItems.pipelines.notifyOnFinish.description: Show a notification when a CI run of your pull requests finishes.

azdoWorkItems.pipelines.showInStatusBar.description: Show the CI runs of your pull requests in the status bar.

azdoWorkItems.reviews.maxWaitHours.description: Hours a pull request may wait for reviewers (team rule), counted from its publication. Overdue PRs are shown in red.

azdoWorkItems.reviews.dueSoonHours.description: Hours before the maximum wait when a pull request is due soon: shown in orange and notified once.

azdoWorkItems.reviews.remindOverdueEvery.description: While a pull request is overdue, how often it is notified again (hours). 0: only once.

azdoWorkItems.reviews.includeOptional.description: Also list the pull requests where you are an optional reviewer. By default only the ones where you are a required reviewer are listed.

enumDescriptions: You are added as reviewer of a pull request (or it is published from draft)
A pull request is due soon (`azdoWorkItems.reviews.dueSoonHours` before the maximum wait)
A pull request is overdue; repeated every `azdoWorkItems.reviews.remindOverdueEveryHours`
The first time VS Code checks each day: one summary of all the pull requests waiting for your review
Someone replies to a comment you started on a pull request you review
A comment you started on a pull request you review is resolved (Resolved, Won't fix, Closed, By design)

azdoWorkItems.reviews.notifications.description: Notifications about the pull requests you review. Empty: none.

azdoWorkItems.reviews.pollIntervalSecond.description: How often the pull requests waiting for your review are checked (seconds).

azdoWorkItems.reviews.showInStatusBar.description: Show how many pull requests are waiting for your review in the status bar.
